# CHIM Engine tracker

<!-- Generated whole by tools/bug_register.py render from docs/bugs/bugs.json and docs/BUG_JOURNAL.md; do not edit by hand. -->

Every bug of the CHIM engine: its streaming and memory, world format, builder, stairs and collision on CHIM worlds, rendering and performance. Generated together with the [bug register](../BUGS.md) from [`bugs.json`](bugs.json); a test fails when this page is stale or a CHIM bug is missing. Which bugs appear here and how to add one: [CHIM bugs](README.md#chim-bugs). Design: [world streamer](../WORLD_STREAMER.md).

CHIM version: 0.2.1. 217 CHIM bugs: 110 open, 101 fixed, 6 closed.

### Persisting, not resolved

Bugs reported two or more times. Most reports first. Each has its report lines on its page.

- [CHIM-AZURA-FLOATING-FLORA-43](bugs/CHIM-AZURA-FLOATING-FLORA-43.md): Plant or tree pieces hang in the air at Azura's Coast (cell 16,7) (reported 7 times, open)
- [BUILD-PIPELINE-UNDERUTILIZATION-36](bugs/BUILD-PIPELINE-UNDERUTILIZATION-36.md): Umbrella: several builder phases run on one core while the rest of the machine idles, and some do work the build no longer needs (reported 5 times, open)
- [BUILD-CHIM-STAIR-WALK-UNCACHED-36](bugs/BUILD-CHIM-STAIR-WALK-UNCACHED-36.md): CHIM frames are stair-walked again on every build: about 69 minutes for 270 frames (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-MAPS-SERIAL-36](bugs/BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-MAPS-SERIAL-36.md): The image step writes the CHIM region cells' .chim maps one by one on half a core, silently (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-OPTIMIZER-CACHE-KEY-BROAD-36](bugs/BUILD-OPTIMIZER-CACHE-KEY-BROAD-36.md): Regression: the image step's BSP optimizer pass cache reused 13 of 2,658 maps; its key covers the whole image tool, so any image-code change redoes every map (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-PROFILER-NO-WASTE-ALARM-36](bugs/BUILD-PROFILER-NO-WASTE-ALARM-36.md): No profiler, perf ledger or gate flagged idle cores, work done for maps that are removed, or growth of the image (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [CHIM-BALMORA-INSET-SLIVERS-43](bugs/CHIM-BALMORA-INSET-SLIVERS-43.md): Balmora's town frame hands over 96 units inside its cells: the 8 cells around the town keep classic strips, built as 15 legacy maps (11.5 MB) with every object of those cells (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [CHIM-FRAME-EDGE-EFRAG-CRASH-36](bugs/CHIM-FRAME-EDGE-EFRAG-CRASH-36.md): R_StoreEfrags: Bad entity type 270440 ends the game: a leaf link to an entity whose model is NULL (normal play in Seyda Neen; noclip past the Vivec frame edge) (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-CHIM-FRAME-SWAP-LATE-36](bugs/BUILD-CHIM-FRAME-SWAP-LATE-36.md): The image step builds 335 legacy maps of cells already on CHIM, then removes them before packing (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-SERIAL-TAIL-36](bugs/BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-SERIAL-TAIL-36.md): After the parallel world build the chim stage ran its validation, heap gate and zone walk on one core (about 10 minutes of the 270-frame coast build) (reported 3 times, open)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-AUDIO-SERIAL-36](bugs/BUILD-IMAGE-AUDIO-SERIAL-36.md): The image step puts the audio payload in one file at a time while 22 of 24 cores sit idle (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-LEGACY-TOWN-MAPS-SHIPPED-36](bugs/BUILD-LEGACY-TOWN-MAPS-SHIPPED-36.md): CHIM-native Seyda Neen is still built through the legacy chain: 65 sn maps are built and removed before packing (build time, not payload) (reported 3 times, open)
- [BUILD-STATS-SERIAL-36](bugs/BUILD-STATS-SERIAL-36.md): The CHIM stats step runs serially and silently on one core (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-READ-RUNS-33](bugs/CHIM-READ-RUNS-33.md): CHIM crossings read little but in many separate runs, so FFS seeks dominate (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-RED-MOUNTAIN-SOLID-SKY-43](bugs/CHIM-RED-MOUNTAIN-SOLID-SKY-43.md): On the Red Mountain summit (cell 2,9) the player ends up inside solid and only the sky is drawn, no terrain (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-VIVEC-DOCK-WALKWAY-43](bugs/CHIM-VIVEC-DOCK-WALKWAY-43.md): The player cannot climb the walkway at the Vivec Hlaalu canton dock and gets stuck (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-ZONE-RELEASE-FLICKER-42](bugs/CHIM-ZONE-RELEASE-FLICKER-42.md): Full CHIM zone: distant buildings pop in and out while standing still, and the retry costs frames (reported 3 times, open)
- [STAIRS-EBONHEART-CHIM-36](bugs/STAIRS-EBONHEART-CHIM-36.md): Three Ebonheart flights fail the CHIM stair gate in the whole-city Vivec frame (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [VIVEC-TEMPLE-STAIRS-33](bugs/VIVEC-TEMPLE-STAIRS-33.md): Palace steps and High Fane quarter flights fail the stair gate on the CHIM Vivec Temple frame (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-IDLE-START-36](bugs/BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-IDLE-START-36.md): The chim stage of the 270-frame coast build spends its first 35-45 minutes on 1-4 cores while it holds 12-24 workers (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-NATIVE-TOWN-36](bugs/BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-NATIVE-TOWN-36.md): The image step of a CHIM-native town read legacy region maps that are never built: the Bitter Coast test build failed at the end of its image step on maps/bc000.bsp (reported 2 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-LEGACY-CHAIN-DEFAULT-36](bugs/BUILD-LEGACY-CHAIN-DEFAULT-36.md): Builds still prepared CHIM towns through the legacy region-map chain by default, and a retired flag (--legacy-area) was accepted with only a warning (reported 2 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-PARTITION-GROWTH-UNGATED-36](bugs/BUILD-PARTITION-GROWTH-UNGATED-36.md): Nothing gates the number of world partitions or the growth of the image (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-SILENT-PHASES-36](bugs/BUILD-SILENT-PHASES-36.md): Builder phases run silent: no start/end timing, no progress, no heartbeat; the CHIM stats step is a single-core tail (reported 2 times, open)
- [CHIM-LEGACY-CHAIN-33](bugs/CHIM-LEGACY-CHAIN-33.md): CHIM builds still run the legacy exterior chain: frame maps read the legacy region maps, and the open world is built (reported 2 times, open)
- [CHIM-TERRAIN-TEXTURE-BLOCKY-43](bugs/CHIM-TERRAIN-TEXTURE-BLOCKY-43.md): Roads and paths on the ground look blocky: each texture square is drawn with hard edges instead of blending into its neighbours (reported 2 times, open)
- [IMAGE-ONE-HDF-TARGET-36](bugs/IMAGE-ONE-HDF-TARGET-36.md): The game ships on two drive images and three world partitions; the project target is the whole game on one HDF (reported 2 times, open)

The closed-space split only checked surface inside the hull, so surface left outside was never seen. Fix on v0.0.43-dockwalk: a piece whose reduced hull leaves a source point more than 0.5 units outside keeps all its points (CHIM models, default on; AMIWIND_COLLISION_HULL_POINTS=extremes keeps the old method); the dock goes from 17 to 22 pieces with nothing below the planks. Planned A/B, first option the maintainer's (20:04): (d) DIAGONAL SPLITS: where a square's texture meets a different texture on two adjacent sides (a corner of a stair-step edge), split that square along its diagonal into two triangles, each with one texture, so stair-steps become 45-degree edges (marching-squares over the texture grid; about one extra face per split square, no new textures).
